title: Body sync
summary: The sync seam through which one endpoint's Box3D bodies are written to bytes and applied from bytes (ids with generations, authority with optimistic claims and host assignments, holders, settled holds), with a naive stub implementation; and a network-physics stand: up to four worlds in one process over net_link_sim and coop-net, scenes as data, text scenarios of actions and network conditions, metrics as JSON and end-of-run invariants.
provides: body_sync_create / bind / unbind / body / seat_joined / seat_left: the seam on one endpoint's world
body_sync_claim / release / poll_claim / answer / assign / authority / is_local / set_holder / set_flags: authority with claim sequences
body_sync_receive_state / receive_record / apply / collect / write_state / state_sent / unresolved / resolve / peek_record / pop_record: the tick
body_sync_render_offset / traffic / implementation: what is drawn and measured
body_sync_scene_* and body_sync_scene_catalog: scenes as data and the 8-scene catalog
body_sync_scenario_parse / load: the scenario text format
body_sync_stand_create / tick / run / report / world_hash / body_count / body / write_json / save_json / main: the stand
